task: independent pinned-source screening before answer selection

model_diagnostic.note: Uncalibrated sentence-pair diagnostic; no model-based quarantine or accuracy claim.

qa_diagnostic.note: Independent source is matched by document identity. No legitimate revisions or new-source cases establish a deployable false-flag rate.

limitations: The attacker cannot change the pinned preattack corpus or its manifest.
This recognizes unauthorized source changes, not factual falsity in an approved source.
Validation questions and attack families were previously inspected.
A new legitimate document is also unreviewed until an operator approves it.
